findings.title: Populated editor control polish
items: .secondary uses --line-strong (sampled 167,171,172 = 2.32:1 on white; dark 3.48:1) beside --ky-field-border inputs (4.54:1 / 5.32:1): Comment and header Save. styles.css:476. One-token change to --ky-field-border; also meets the >=3:1 control-border contract.

Control text sizes: .note-search, .comment-compose input/button and header Save inherit 16px (cap 12-13px) above the 15px body, beside 14px editor actions and 13px toolbar. Set them to --ky-type-nav (or body) so a view has one control scale.
Desktop pane edges: toggle text x17 / chevron 218 vs content x21 / chevron 214 (and rows x30). Align the pane padding to one inset.
findings.disclosure: Pre-existing since stage 07/08. Round 5 missed items 1-2 (I scored typography 8). These are corrections, not regressions. Projected gain to >=8 after recapture is unproven.

items: Add-section "+" beside Quick Notes is a faint sub-40px glyph.

Document body inset 25px (desktop) / 17px (phone) from the title edge.
Empty desktop shows "Saved to server" before anything exists.
Header Settings link has no current-page state.
Phone Settings link cloud and orphan subtitle (owner-deferred).
Dark radios use the UA neutral grey (59,59,59), off-token.
